description:
Park Wonjang decides to become a doctor after seeing the perfect image of doctor on TV when he was a child.  
After many years of hardship, he become a doctor of internal medicine and opens his own clinic. He thought that finally he could make much money. But his expectation is far from reality. Making things worse, he also suffers from hair loss.
